description: This interface defines methods related to authorities for resource access control, including authorization checks and retrieving claims.

classes.name: Authorities
classes.description: An interface representing a collection of authorities granted on resources and operations, providing methods for authorization checks and claim retrieval.

methods.name: isAuthorized (ResourceIdentifier resourceId, Activity intent)
methods.description: Checks if the authorities include claims allowing an activity on a specified resource.

methods.name: isAuthorized (ResourceIdentifier resourceId, String operation)
methods.description: Checks if the authorities include claims allowing execution of a specified operation on a resource.

methods.name: asMap()
methods.description: Retrieves the authorities as a map of claims.
